report.clinical_summary: 58-year-old software engineer presenting with 6-month fatigue, recent night sweats (1 month), progressive neck pain (3 weeks), and lymphadenopathy. No current prescription medications, occasional OTC pain reliever for neck pain. Increased job stress and longer hours over past 4 weeks coinciding with symptom progression. Primary care physician referred for evaluation.
